nodes.description: Owner address state variable stored in Ownable; controls privileged functions.
Ownable constructor that sets owner to the deploying sender.
onlyOwner function setting owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function forwarding the new owner to _transferOwnership.
Internal function that validates and assigns the new owner.
Boolean lock used by the nonReentrant modifier.
Modifier toggling reentrancyLock around guarded execution.
Public conversion path array of IERC20Token used for Bancor conversion.
Public address receiving converted tokens or withdrawn funds.
Public minimum conversion rate configuration value.
Public IContractRegistry used to resolve the Bancor network address.
Constant bytes32 name used to look up the Bancor network contract.
Constructor initializing path, registry, destination wallet and min conversion rate.
onlyOwner setter for the conversion path array.
onlyOwner setter for the Bancor registry contract.
onlyOwner setter for the minimum conversion rate.
onlyOwner setter for the destination wallet address.
Internal nonReentrant function converting ETH to tokens via the Bancor network.
onlyOwner nonReentrant function transferring stray ERC20 tokens to the destination wallet.
onlyOwner nonReentrant function transferring locked ETH to the destination wallet.
Payable fallback function that triggers convertToInd.
View helper returning the resolved Bancor network address from the registry.
msg.sender used as the initial owner in the Ownable constructor.
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender recorded in the conversionSucceded event emitted by convertToInd.
External payable call bancorNetwork.convertFor.value(msg.value)(path,msg.value,minReturn,destinationWallet).
External call anyToken.transfer(destinationWallet, balanceOf(this)) inside withdrawToken.
External ETH send destinationWallet.transfer(address(this).balance) inside withdrawEther.
External call bancorRegistry.getAddress(BANCOR_NETWORK) resolving the network contract.
Address parameter of transferOwnership/_transferOwnership.
IERC20Token[] path parameter of the IndTokenPayment constructor.
Destination wallet address parameter of the constructor.
Bancor registry address parameter of the constructor.
Minimum conversion rate parameter of the constructor.
IERC20Token[] path parameter of setConversionPath.
Registry address parameter of setBancorRegistry.
Rate parameter of setMinConversionRate.
Wallet address parameter of setDestinationWallet.
IERC20Token parameter of withdrawToken identifying the token to withdraw.
Local IBancorNetwork instance derived from the registry lookup in convertToInd.
Local minimum return value hardcoded to 1 in convertToInd.
Local variable holding the token amount returned by the Bancor conversion.

edges.reason: msg.sender flows into the Ownable constructor.
Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
renounceOwnership writes owner = address(0).
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership.
_newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
_newOwner parameter is assigned to owner in _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership updates the owner state variable.
nonReentrant modifier toggles the reentrancyLock state variable.
setConversionPath writes the path state variable.
setBancorRegistry writes the bancorRegistry state variable.
setMinConversionRate writes the minConversionRate state variable.
setDestinationWallet writes the destinationWallet state variable.
_path constructor parameter initializes the path state variable.
destWalletAddr constructor parameter initializes destinationWallet.
bancorRegistryAddr constructor parameter initializes bancorRegistry.
minConvRate constructor parameter initializes minConversionRate.
_path setter parameter flows into setConversionPath.
Registry address parameter flows into setBancorRegistry.
Rate parameter flows into setMinConversionRate.
Wallet address parameter flows into setDestinationWallet.
anyToken parameter flows into withdrawToken.
Constructor assigns the provided path array to the path state variable.
Constructor assigns destinationWallet from the provided address.
Constructor assigns minConversionRate from the provided value.
Constructor assigns bancorRegistry from the provided address.
bancorRegistry state variable is the target of the external getAddress call.
BANCOR_NETWORK constant is used as the registry lookup key.
Registry lookup result is cast into the local bancorNetwork variable.
Local bancorNetwork instance invokes convertFor on the external network.
Registry-resolved address ultimately feeds the Bancor conversion call.
path state variable is passed into the external convertFor call.
destinationWallet state variable is passed as the _for argument of convertFor.
Hardcoded minReturn of 1 is passed into the external conversion call.
Return value of the external conversion is stored in convTokens.
convTokens result is asserted and event-emitted inside convertToInd.
msg.sender is recorded in the conversionSucceded event emitted by convertToInd.
convertToInd performs the external Bancor convertFor call.
withdrawToken performs the external anyToken.transfer call.
withdrawEther performs the external ETH transfer to destinationWallet.
getBancorContractAddress queries bancorRegistry.getAddress.
Payable fallback invokes the internal convertToInd conversion routine.
External Bancor conversion can re-enter the payable fallback while ETH/tokens are in flight.
External token transfer may re-enter withdrawToken before state settles.
ETH transfer to destinationWallet may call back into the payable fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner parameter is only used to update owner inside _transferOwnership.
_path constructor parameter is consumed directly by the IndTokenPayment constructor.
destWalletAddr constructor parameter is consumed directly by the IndTokenPayment constructor.
bancorRegistryAddr constructor parameter is consumed directly by the IndTokenPayment constructor.
minConvRate constructor parameter is consumed directly by the IndTokenPayment constructor.
_path setter parameter is only used by setConversionPath.
Registry address parameter is only used by setBancorRegistry.
Rate parameter is only used by setMinConversionRate.
Wallet address parameter is only used by setDestinationWallet.
anyToken parameter is only used by withdrawToken to build the transfer call.
Local bancorNetwork instance exists solely to invoke the external convertFor operation.
Local minReturn is a constant argument of the external convertFor call.
Local convTokens holds and asserts the result of the conversion inside convertToInd.
